description: Real recorded heavy composite incident: a four-component composite (hotel rate, mongodb, geo, user) with 261 firing-stream transitions -- the stress fixture for the firing sink and event-id attribution at scale.
scrubbed: detector-firings.jsonl: copied verbatim; its fields carry no environment-specific detail. incident_id (app-name+epoch-nanos) and recorded_at kept because event_id is content-addressed over them and the replay re-derives the real recorded ids.

closure.json: only detector_timeline + the three analysis booleans extracted from sdo_production_receipt_strict.json; the receipt's pod uid, session id, absolute artifact paths, commit SHAs, and image refs are not copied.
No per-incident RuntimeState dump exists in stored results, so no state.json; the state-round-trip dimension does not run for this fixture.
